intro: Every project below is a real home in Northeastern Pennsylvania, listed with the square count and the shingle line we actually installed. We publish those details because they are the part a homeowner can check: a 28-square asphalt replacement in Clarks Green finished in a single day, a 53-square hail replacement in Dickson City done in two, a two-layer tear-off in Scranton where the crew left the job site cleaner than they found it. Roofing, siding, soffit, fascia and seamless gutters — installed by our own crews and backed by Owens Corning's longest available warranty.
